captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a bicycle track floor pump. It features a grey cylindrical steel barrel resting on a wide black rectangular foot base, with a black hose clipped to its side. At the top, a black T-handle is connected to a thin silver piston rod. A round analog pressure gauge is mounted near the base, complete with a white face and a red indicator needle. The handle and its piston rod translate vertically along the barrel axis, the gauge needle rotates on its central pivot, and a sleeve grip on one side of the crossbar rotates continuously around its axis.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a bicycle track floor pump. The assembly must include a rectangular base, a grey cylindrical barrel, a black hose clipped to the side, and a round pressure gauge with a rotatable red needle. It should also feature a black T-handle on a silver piston rod that can slide vertically, and a rotating sleeve grip on the handle crossbar.
captions.factory: The model is built using an ArticulatedObject system. The base is constructed as a Box primitive, while the main pump barrel, hose, and clips are created using Cylinder and Box primitives. The pressure gauge is composed of a Cylinder for the housing and a thin Box for the red indicator needle. The piston handle assembly is modeled with a thin Cylinder for the rod, a central Cylinder for the handle T-junction, and horizontal Cylinders for the grips. Joints are defined using prismatic articulation for the vertical piston movement, revolute articulation for the gauge needle, and continuous articulation for the handle's sleeve grip.
